attempts.review_text:
Review of 1e4848e5046cb1b5c4c4826a1998a87c762e31a6 (codex quality review)

Review of 1e4848e5046cb1b5c4c4826a1998a87c762e31a6: workflow-file proposals fail because the proposal token lacks workflow-write permission. Assessment used the supplied API snapshot; additional GitHub API and upstream-source reads were unavailable.

[P1] Grant workflow-write permission to the proposal token
At head `1e4848e5046cb1b5c4c4826a1998a87c762e31a6`, a model proposal that edits `.github/workflows/gate.yml` and supplies both outcome files reaches `create-pull-request` with a token restricted to contents and pull-request permissions. GitHub rejects workflow-file pushes without `workflows: write`, so this supported proposal fails instead of opening a PR. Request `permission-workflows: write` on this PR-only token and ensure the App installation grants it.

[P2] Select the previous receipt for the same upkeep brief
When Monday's panel follows a successful morning model receipt, `.comments[-1]` contains that model receipt rather than the previous week's panel receipt. This supplies the wrong baseline to `upkeep-panel`, causing it to omit the preceding week's upstream changes or mark its comparison unavailable. Filter receipt history by the selected brief before choosing the latest receipt.
